meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 引导操作员创建第一个 DM 频道的 agent：选择频道、确认用户 ID 与显示名，然后运行脚本创建 agent 组并触发一条欢迎 DM 发送到操作员私聊。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置且服务运行中，你想为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 agent 时触发。通常用于首次设置，引导选择频道并确认身份。

say.text: 帮我创建第一个 DM 频道 agent。
say.note: 引导你选择频道并确认身份。

say.text: 初始化第一个 agent，频道用 Discord。
say.note: 会询问你的 Discord ID 和显示名。

say.text: 设置第一个 agent，我选 Telegram。
say.note: 可能需要通过配对码完成身份确认。

howto.what_en: Walks the operator through creating the first agent for a DM channel: pick a channel, confirm user ID and display name, then run a script that creates the agent group and triggers a welcome DM to the operator's DM.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create the first agent for a DM channel, after channel credentials are configured and the service is running. Typically used for initial setup, guiding channel selection and identity confirmation.

say_en.text: Help me create the first DM channel agent.
say_en.note: Guides channel selection and identity confirmation.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent, using Discord as the channel.
say_en.note: Asks for your Discord ID and display name.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent, I'll choose Telegram.
say_en.note: May require a pairing code to confirm your identity.
